newsitem.title: ZAIRE: New Congo government Thursday night - minister.
newsitem.headline: New Congo government Thursday night - minister.

text.p: The composition of the new government in the Democratic Republic of Congo will be announced on Thursday night, a senior member of the victorious Alliance said.
"I will announce the composition of the government at 8.30 p.m. (1930 GMT) at the latest," Raphael Ghenda, the Alliance's information commissioner, told reporters.

Asked if new head of state Laurent Kabila had met or would meet veteran opposition leader Etienne Tshisekedi on Thursday, Ghenda replied: "I have no idea about that. I have just left the president (Kabila) and he was not with Mr Tshisekedi".
Ghenda said he did not know if Tshisekedi would be in the new government.

Kabila's Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo-Zaire (ADFL) captured Kinshasa on May 17 and controls almost all of Africa's third largest country. Former President Mobutu Sese Seko is in exile, currently in Togo.
A Tshisekedi aide said earlier on Thursday his chief would meet Kabila, for the first time since the Alliance's victory, at 2 p.m. (1300 GMT). But two hours later no meeting had taken place.
